# The Fastest On Demand Packaging Machine

The fully-automated X6® machine system is the highest throughput erected box-making machine on the market and first to produce ready-to-pack boxes and trays.

## Increase Throughput With the Fastest and Most Versatile On Demand Packaging® Machine

Delivering up to 1,300 boxes and trays per hour, the fully-automated X6 is fast and versatile, with the ability to produce boxes small enough to fit through an envelope slot and right-sized trays that can replace totes in warehouse automation systems.

Up to 1,300 boxes per hour Produce a box every 2.4 seconds

56’ 3" x 7’ 5” Fully-loaded footprint

Up to 6 functions Fully-automated

## Meet High-Volume Demand 

The X6 can meet high-volume demand, allowing e-commerce businesses to fulfill order with speed and efficiency. With the ability to produce both boxes with flaps (FEFCO 415) and right-sized trays (FEFCO 453), it allows for integration with leading warehouse automation systems including autonomous mobile robots (AMR), automated guided vehicles (AGV), and automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS). 

## Ship Smart and Sustainably 

The X6 makes the smallest on-demand boxes available on the market, replacing the need for environmentally harmful plastic polymailers, and providing a sustainable shipping solution for smaller products. This supports compliance with newly enacted regulations, such as extended producer responsibility (EPR) bills and the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR). 

## Streamline Packaging Production

The X6 streamlines and enhances packaging production through lean manufacturing. It cuts, creases, glues, erects, and labels ready-to-pack boxes for automated output onto a conveyor, cart, or packstation, and is also available with both box closing or lidding modules to allow for automation of the entire packaging process.

#### Optimize Efficiency

The X6 enhances the ability for businesses to meet customer requirements and resolve labor and associated costs, while improving packaging speed to address variable shipping requirements. 

## Automated Tray Lidding for X6® Workflows

Need a complete tray-and-lid packaging solution? The LidPro X™ is designed to pair with the Packsize X6® to create sealed, right-sized tray packaging in one streamlined workflow. Built for high-volume fulfillment environments, it applies lids quickly and consistently across varying tray dimensions while helping maintain packaging efficiency and throughput.
